kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Prosecutors are reexamining a Cornell fraternity rape case. Here's what we know
wire.summary: New York prosecutors are reopening an investigation into an alleged rape case at Cornell University in 2024. The alleged victim recently filed a lawsuit against seven members of Chi Phi fraternity.

wire.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
wire.summary: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.

wire.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
wire.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

wire.title: SpaceX's Starship launches on first orbital mission from Texas
wire.summary: Starship is key to SpaceX's commercial success and NASA's plans to land humans on the moon. This is the 14th flight of the uncrewed Starship, but the first time it reached orbit.

wire.title: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
wire.summary: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

wire.title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
wire.summary: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.

wire.title: U.K. examines if Iran or Russia are involved in foiled attack near base used by U.S.
wire.summary: Five men arrested on terror charges near a U.S.-run air force base were released on bail, as detectives investigate lines of inquiry, including whether a foreign state or armed group was involved.

wire.title: What to know about the $810 million in spending canceled by President Trump
wire.summary: President Trump announced plans to cancel $810 million in Congressionally approved spending, a move that some in his own party are calling illegal.

wire.title: How to limit the rat numbers? Train the humans
wire.summary: D.C.'s Rat Rangers take anyone who is interested on night time safaris through some of the Capitol's filthiest back alleys to learn the way of the rats, and to be better humans.

wire.title: Schools are experimenting with AI with little evidence or policy to guide them
wire.summary: Teachers are using AI to develop lesson plans, and in some districts, AI chatbots give students feedback on their work. Meanwhile, the research around how AI can help students is extremely limited.

wire.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
wire.summary: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

wire.title: Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
wire.summary: Last week Zelensky revealed Ukraine had sent two captured North Koreans to South Korea - which Seoul says was meant to be a secret.

wire.title: Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July. Here's what we know so far
wire.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says the murders are a "stain on our national conscience".

wire.title: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
wire.summary: Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.

wire.title: Nigerian attempts to break world record by dancing non-stop for seven days
wire.summary: Crowds have gathered in Lagos to watch Ben Dancer, who says he will carry on dancing until Tuesday morning.

wire.title: Stand-up comic released after being convicted of insulting Erdoğan
wire.summary: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktaş also faces a travel ban but has been released due to time served.
